title: CPSC, Baby Trend Announce Recall of Certain Baby Trend "Passport" Strollers
summary: The fold joint can collapse unexpectedly, causing the baby to fall. Units: 11,300.

title: CPSC, Coaster Co. of America Announce Recall of Bunk Beds
summary: A gap between the step of the built-in ladder and the top bunk allows enough room for a child's body to slip through but will not allow for a child's head to pass through. This poses a serious strangulation risk. Federal standards for bunk beds are designed to protect children against entrapment and

title: CPSC, DK Publishing Announce Recall of Children's Board Books with Sound Maker
summary: The sound maker mounted inside a plastic covering on the last page of the books poses a choking hazard to young children if removed. Units: About 214,000.

title: CPSC, E & B Giftware LLC Announce Recall of Universal Electric Outlet Adaptor Plugs
summary: Multiple metal plugs can be extended from the product at one time. Consumers touching an exposed plug, while the adaptor is inserted into an electric outlet, can receive an electric shock. Units: About 187,000.

title: CPSC, Shaw Industries Announce Recall of Flammable Carpet
summary: Due to a manufacturing error that over-treated the carpet with a "soil-resist" application, the carpet could readily ignite, presenting a serious risk of burn injuries. The recalled carpet violates the federal Flammable Fabrics Act. Units: 2,300 square yards of carpet (approximately 125 pieces of ca

title: CPSC, Casio Inc. Announce Recall of Piano Benches
summary: The screws and bracket assemblies attaching the legs to the bench can weaken and detach, causing the bench seat to collapse during normal use. Units: 18,000.

title: CPSC, Fluke Corp. Announce Recall of Electrical Testing Components
summary: The leads, which are used to connect probes to handheld digital multimeters when testing for the presence and amount of voltage present in electrical circuitry, can result in incorrect multimeter readings. This poses a serious shock or electrocution hazard, if the consumer touches live wires that th

title: CPSC, A. O. Smith Co. Announce Recall of Spas
summary: The motor in the circulating pump can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 25.

title: CPSC, Backyard Products Announce Recall of Swings
summary: Chains on the swing can detach during use, and cause the child to fall to the ground and possibly suffer injuries. Units: 47,600.

title: CPSC, Front Porch Classics Announce Recall of "Old Century Dread Pirate™" Coffee Table Games
summary: The surface coating and the metal in the ships contain lead and pose a risk of lead poisoning to young children. A child could ingest lead by swallowing a broken part of the ship or by repeatedly mouthing the ships. Units: 2,000.

title: CPSC, Pier 1 Imports Announce Recall of Tea Light Candleholders
summary: The beads on these tea light candleholders can catch fire during use. Units: 48,000.

title: CPSC, Turbo Power Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Hand-held Hair Dryers
summary: These electric hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection device to prevent electrocution, if the hair dryer falls into water. Such electric shock protection devices are required by industry standards for all electric hand-held hair dryers. Units: 395,000.

title: CPSC, Oki Data Announce Recall of Fax Machines
summary: The fax machines may incur a mechanical malfunction, posing a shock hazard to users. Units: 1,000.

title: CPSC, The Fondue Factory LLC Announce Recall to Replace Glass Stands on Fondue Sets
summary: The top piece of glass that supports the fondue pot can shatter, posing a burn and laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 500.

title: CPSC, LB International Inc. Announce Recall of Fold-Away Ladders Sold by Hammacher Schlemmer
summary: A rung on these aluminum, multi-purpose ladders can release or the side rail can bend unexpectedly. If that happens, the ladder can collapse, causing the user to fall. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, Avon Products Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Snowman Nightlight Diffuser
summary: The scented oil can drip, causing the nightlight base to crack or break, exposing electrical wire or metal parts inside the nightlight, thus causing a potential shock hazard. There is also a risk of cuts, if the nightlight breaks. Units: 333,000.

title: CPSC, Great Gifts Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmen Holiday Lamps
summary: These electric holiday lamps have undersized wiring, no strain relief on the electric cords, and the molded plastic enclosure is flammable. The lamps pose fire and electrocution hazards. Units: 1,900.

title: CPSC and CESSO, LLC Announce Recall of Tree Stand Components
summary: If the "Tree Lounge" is subjected to significant impact from a heavy load, a tube on the leveler can crack. title: CPSC, Genan Import Inc. Announce Recall of Kinetic Lighting Pictures
summary: These pictures have inadequate construction, incorrect wiring, and use flammable materials, all of which pose fire and electric shock hazards to consumers. Units: 17,760.

title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of Martha Stewart Everyday® Safety Matches
summary: These matches may ignite upon impact, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 588 boxes.
